note: The IEOM's observatory of bank charges in the Pacific collectivities (its half-yearly report of April-July 2026, prices at 1 April 2026), French Polynesia's table: keeping an account costs 3,824 francs CFP a year at the Banque de Polynésie, 3,804 at the Banque de Tahiti and 4,596 at the Banque Socredo; the payment institutions in the same table (Marara Paiement, EGPF) aren't banks and aren't taken.
